## Triage: decision-box entry check. Not a product fork: it honours a declared field with an already-ruled precedence. `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow`, into `pm:queue`

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T21:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Entry check:** the 速读, workload, facets and prior-rulings line are present.
- **Why it leaves the box:** `FlowSchema.successMessage` is declared for "every terminal run (not only screen flows)". The straight-through path drops it, so this is a declared contract the renderer does not honour (class b). The precedence (action, then flow, then default) is already set for the paused path (objectstack-ai/objectui#12246). Nothing here is a fork. B would keep a known contract break.
- **Direction:** the card's A, as its "After the ruling" describes.
  - On a straight-through launch the success toast reads the action's message, then the flow's `successMessage`, then the default, through the paused path's one rule. ⛔ Not a second copy.
  - Refused and failed runs still show no success toast.
  - It is pinned beside objectstack-ai/objectui#12246's pins.
- `needs-user-decision` is removed.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (triage `6133357796`: the card's A; a straight-through flow launch's success toast reads the action's message, then the flow's `successMessage`, then the default, through the paused path's one rule, ⛔ not a second copy)

Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12274-flow-done-success-message`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12274`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the straight-through flow launch and the one precedence rule, read on objectui `main` `1fb1ced` at 2026-10-12T22:57Z (stop on breach; explain in the report):
- **The drop:** `packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`. `judgeFlowLaunch` reads the served `successMessage` into the `done` outcome, and the launch handler's `case 'done'` returns `{ success: true, data, reload }` without it.
- **The one rule:** the paused path's terminal toast in `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` (`invokingActionMessage(state) || outcome.successMessage || flowRunner.completed`, from objectui#12246). It is shared or extracted, ⛔ never re-typed.
- **The runner's toast,** read: `@object-ui/core`'s `ActionRunner` success toast (`outcomeMessages`, then `successMessage`, then the default). `@object-ui/types`'s `ActionResult` carries no message member today.
- Co-located tests beside objectui#12246's paused-path pins, and `.changeset/12274-flow-done-success-message.md`.
- ⛔ No new spec key. Refused and failed runs still show no success toast.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: one route carries the flow's message to the runner's toast through a new member of `@object-ui/types`'s published `ActionResult`, which widens the published surface; the other route has the console toast through the shared rule with no type change. The dev has not chosen yet, so the claim declares `yes`, and an at-tier contract review runs before the queue whichever route lands.
Responsibility: `objectui's console flow launch (@object-ui/app-shell flowResponse), whose straight-through done arm drops the served successMessage | the paused path already honours it (objectui#12246), and the spec declares FlowSchema.successMessage for every terminal run | every user who triggers a flow-backed action whose flow declares a successMessage and runs without a screen; no reach measured today (the card's facet ②)`
Thread-read: 6133357796
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T22:57Z on objectui `main` `1fb1ced`. No open PR touches `flowResponse.ts`, `FlowRunner.tsx`, `ActionRunner.ts` or `ui-action.ts` (open: objectui#12253, #12262, #12277). Dispatched in the same wave as objectui#12273, whose surface (`AppHeader.tsx` and the language packs) is disjoint.

## Seat ACCEPT: objectui PR #12281 at `ea9415a` · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-12T23:42Z

Verdict: **ACCEPT**. Reviewed on GitHub against the claim `6134218617` and triage `6133357796`, not against the report `6134703066`. It is gated on the at-tier contract review the claim's `Clause-②: yes` declaration owes; the seat hangs `needs:contract-review` on the PR in this act, and the review runs once CI on this head has converged.

**PR form.**
- Draft, base `main`, assignee `zhuangjianguo`. Line 1 is `Fixes #12274` and line 2 is `Clause-②: no`; a scan of the whole body found no other closing verb next to a card number.
- `check-governed-merges --pr` reads NOT governed, 666 lines.

**The line-2 `no` against the claim's `yes`.** The claim declared `yes` before the route was chosen, because route (a) would have added a member to `@object-ui/types`' `ActionResult`. The dev took route (b) and measured that no published member moves: `flowResponse.ts` and `flowLaunch.ts` sit outside `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `exports` (`.` and `./styles.css`). The declaration limb still binds the queue, so the at-tier review confirms or refutes that `no` on the diff.

**The diff, read.**
- **One rule, not two:** `flowSuccessCopy(actionMessage, flowMessage)` in `utils/flowResponse.ts` is the action's copy, then the flow's, under one `usableCopy` predicate.
  - `FlowRunner`'s terminal toast now calls it, and its private `invokingActionMessage` is deleted, not copied.
  - `judgeFlowLaunch`'s `done` arm calls it. When the flow's copy wins, the result goes `silent` and carries `successToast`, which `launchConsoleFlow` speaks once for both hosts. When the action's copy wins, or neither exists, the `done` result is unchanged, so the runner's own rungs and default apply as before.
- Refused and failed runs never reach `done`, so there is no success toast on either path. That matches triage's direction.

**The dev's open question (each end's default sentence), answered by the seat, not escalated.**
- Triage's direction reads "the action's message, then the flow's `successMessage`, then the default". On this path the card names the default as the runner's own ("otherwise its default").
- Unifying the two ends' default sentences is an undeclared preference that grows the change (option B).
- So the PR's option A stands: one shared precedence for the author's copy, and each end keeps its default. If the maintainer wants identical defaults, that is a new card.

**The changeset and docs, sentence by sentence.**
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`: "closes with the flow's own `successMessage` when the action declares none", "When the action declares a message, the straight-through toast is unchanged", "When neither does, each path keeps its own default text", "A refused or failed run still shows no success toast" and "No exported type or prop changes" (the at-tier review re-reads this last one). Each sentence is true of the diff.
- The `architecture-overview.md` table cell restates the same precedence.

**Accepted deviations.**
- `utils/flowLaunch.ts` was added to the surface. It is the one caller of `judgeFlowLaunch`, the one place the action's copy exists, and shared by both hosts.
- The guide line was added.
- On the paused path, a whitespace-only flow `successMessage` now counts as no copy (the shared predicate). This is pinned at unit level and named in the PR.

**Evidence, as reported.** Pins in both hosts and on both doors cover cases (i)–(iv), plus 9 unit tests. Ablation 1 (the done arm's flow branch) turns 5 red, and ablation 2 (the `successToast` line) turns 3 red; both were restored blob-equal to HEAD. The two out-of-scope notes (the `${result.*}` filling asymmetry, and the runtime-only `ActionDef.toast` options) are Acceptance notes with no carrier.

**Next (the seat's).**
- CI on `ea9415a` is converging.
- Then an isolated at-tier contract review renders its record on this head.
- On PASS: strip `needs:contract-review`, then `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
